_doc: Parts for the parts-to-pallet task (PLAN.md 2.1). Lengths in metres at size scale 1.0; every part comes in the three
scales of 'sizes'. Local frame: z up, origin at the centre. 'dims' = full extent (x, y, z) of the part's bounding box.
Top-down grasp: the fingers close along the part's local y ('grip_width' = local y extent); 'yaw_period_deg' is the
yaw symmetry of the part, used together with the gripper's own 180 deg symmetry to pick the grasp yaw.
'split': 'train' parts/colours appear in the training data; 'heldout' only on the TARGET part of the heldout_* eval
splits (PLAN 2.6; the other parts of those episodes are training parts).
Gripper max opening 75 mm -> every grip_width x max(sizes) must stay <= 0.060 (checked by humanoid_pallet_plan.py).
long_bar (200x30x30, L4 only) is not included: L3/L4 were cut on 2026-10-05.

hex_prism.name: hex nut
hex_prism._note: hexagonal prism, 36 mm across flats (local y), corners on local x; convex mesh (no hole)

pallet._doc: 2 rows (along the pallet's local x, i.e. away from the robot) x 3 columns (local y). Static tray on the table.
pallet._jitter_note: largest jitter for which the inner area of all 6 cells stays in the shared workspace (2026-10-05)
